domainAndDisplayReview.soc: End-SoC buckets are below20,20..80,above80..below95,95..100. Arrival buckets are below10,10..below20,20..below50,50plus. Shares use eligible observations and median ignores invalid/missing entries. Labels explicitly distinguish observations from dwell time.
domainAndDisplayReview.index: Four weighted deductions (30/30/20/20); score withheld until at least5 eligible session ends,5 arrivals,3 classified-energy sessions and80% energy classification coverage. Monthly thresholds are3/3/2. This is a descriptive heuristic, not a calibrated battery-damage model despite UI use of the word calibrated.
domainAndDisplayReview.energyAccounting: Raw Wh sum only positive finite session energy. Unknown energy stays its own bucket; all-energy shares include unknown, while DC KPI divides by classified AC+DC Wh only. Coverage is classified Wh/total Wh, not row-count coverage. No charger loss, net battery energy, signed export/regen or cost claim is supported.
domainAndDisplayReview.classification: Explicit AC labels are checked before DC labels. Unlabeled peak power strictly above20000W infers DC; other energy remains unknown. Inference is described in methodology but each inferred row is not separately displayed.
domainAndDisplayReview.rawSi: No hook-side conversion. CareEnergy uses useUnits.formatEnergy; methodology uses useUnits.formatPower for20000W. Cache/model retain Wh/W. Signed energy is excluded by positive-energy eligibility rather than abs/clamp conversion; physical signed drive-energy fields are not consumed.
domainAndDisplayReview.locale: Main percentages/energy/index and monthly fallback/table cells use current shared preferences. Fresh canonical-English lookup resolves113 literal keys. Dates bypass explicit preference options; several count interpolations/axis ticks remain raw, documented under limits/candidates.
domainAndDisplayReview.timezone: Coverage start/end use browser defaults, whereas grouping is UTC and the chart keeps YYYY-MM keys. UTC bucket basis is not explicitly disclosed in chart copy. No workspace date bounds are applied.
domainAndDisplayReview.preferences: useUnits uses the current settings bridge; useNumberFormatting subscribes to formatter preferences. The page writes no settings, table IDs, palette selections, chart hidden-series state or unit defaults. Rendered preference-change behavior is NOTRUN.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Known bars forward current chartTokens.series CSS light-dark(...) colors without fill='solid'. MetricBar defaults to gradient and appends the hex-alpha suffix99 to the supplied color. The actual emitted string is linear-gradient(90deg, light-dark(#385e7e, #91b4d2)99, light-dark(#385e7e, #91b4d2)), which is not a valid CSS color stop.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: A separately assigned owner can use existing fill='solid' for these token colors; preserve values, labels, bins, motion and unknown rendering. No shared token/MetricBar rewrite is needed for this page.
confirmedFindings.limit: CSS string construction is confirmed; no browser computed-style, painted fill or screenshot result is claimed.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: No received payload plus no fatalError always selects Skeleton, even when isRefreshBlocked proves the first fetch is paused. The same predicate feeds specialistState.isLoading and monthly ChartContainer.loading, so paused sections remain loading indefinitely beside their unavailable notice.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: Separately distinguish actively pending from initial paused/unavailable while retaining every shell, source identity and recovery.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: The initial blocked-source message asserts 'paused while offline', but its only predicate is isRefreshBlocked from fetchStatus==='paused'. No online/connectivity evidence is consulted; a paused query alone does not prove the reason or a device outage.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Per-source initial QueryError requires composite trust.hasData. When one source fails and the sibling is pending/paused with no payload, combineDataStates has no fatalError (not all sources failed), the composite displays loading, and this condition hides the failed source's retry in summary/risk/trend/habits/methodology. Its dedicated single-source panel still exposes an error, so this is not a claim that all retry is lost.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: Surface each source's initial failure independently of whether its sibling has delivered data; do not make the whole page fatal.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: With one history received and the other unavailable/pending, the page feeds [] for the absent source, model coverage returns length0, and composite hasData permits methodology content. It then prints numeric0 for returned/eligible observations of the unreceived source. The readonly specialist adapter has already discarded individual source availability. Authoritative empty[] and not-yet-received are consequently indistinguishable in these four metrics, although source notices identify partial state.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: Carry per-source availability into count presentation; show unknown for unreceived counts and preserve genuine zero from a resolved empty array. Do not replace the pure model with ad-hoc fetches.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Both coverage dates call formatDate without locale/tz options. That helper explicitly falls back to browser locale/timezone, not the app's saved locale/timezone_user/tz_display_default. Coverage labels can therefore disagree with selected display preferences. Monthly aggregation is additionally UTC without explicit UTC-bucket copy; no regrouping or 12/24-hour defect is claimed for a date-only label.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: A separately assigned owner should use existing effective date preferences; any UTC-bucket disclosure/catalog integration belongs to an explicitly assigned trend/catalog owner, not a new timezone engine.
confirmedFindings.limit: Source preference bypass confirmed; actual browser date strings and timezone-boundary screenshots NOTRUN.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: The always-mounted ranked badge chooses success solely because opportunities.length===0. That is also the value before either source arrives and while the score is uncalibrated/fatal/empty; the body later explains that evidence is insufficient, but the badge already paints successful '0 ranked'. Absence of calibrated evidence is not a source-confirmed success.
confirmedFindings.nextStep: Use neutral/building/unavailable badge semantics until evidence supports a calibrated no-opportunity conclusion; preserve the advice and ranking thresholds.
